newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Stg seen testing higher but steady today.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Stg seen testing higher but steady today.

text.p: Tuesday's rally above 2.83 marks and to within a whisker of $1.64 gives sterling a firm base for another test higher but for today at least sideways trading looks the most likely scenario, analysts said.
"The cable bounce yesterday is encouraging," said Gerry Celaya, senior technical analyst at American Express Bank. "Sideways trading above $1.63 is likely then higher through $1.64 for $1.6550."
A cable break lower below $1.63 will set up a move down to strong trendline support at $1.6220.
At 0723 GMT the pound was trading at 2.8182/92 and $1.6346/56, barely changed from Tuesday's 2.8180/90 and $1.6367/77.

On cable the $1.6350 is resistance, being the 38.2 Fibonacci retracement of the move down between late December and the middle of March. $1.6500 is a 50-percent retracement and $1.6660 a 61.8-percent retracement of the same move.
Sterling/mark will hold the previous support area around 2.81 but on the upside, trendline resistance is pegged around 2.8440, analysts said.
RSI - 14 day: Sterling/mark: 62 pct, sterling/dollar: 56 pct
